description: Block 64×64 architectural-formula provider — reads normative T1 spec and returns typed PerfEstimate objects per domain/op/shape. Current artifact is uncalibrated; future RTL fields are schema-only synthetic fixtures.

mxu.description: Block 64×64 GEMM: M/K/N tiles with double-buffer overlap

sfu.description: SFU pipeline: 128-wide, 7 operators with per-op pipeline depths

vector.description: Vector engine: 128-wide SIMD ALU + reduce_tree + type_convert

dma.description: DMA engine: descriptor + transfer + burst overhead

kv_cache.description: KV cache: token-position access + layer-switch reload

sw_overhead.description: SW overhead: assumption-only, not in canonical total

reject_policies.unknown_domain: Reject any domain not in supported_domains (fail-closed)
reject_policies.unsupported_op: Reject op not in domain's supported_ops list
reject_policies.out_of_domain: Reject estimate request from a domain not covered by this provider
reject_policies.legacy_source: Reject if caller imports sim.models or sim.engine (numerical-kernel bypass)
reject_policies.rtl_calibrated: Reject any artifact with calibration_state=rtl_calibrated or basis=rtl_measurement (not verdict-eligible)
reject_policies.future_rtl_fields: rtl_head, eda_version, testbench_hash, raw_log_hash, fit_matrix_hash parse but exclude artifact from verdict eligibility

future_rtl_fields_synthetic.note: SYNTHETIC FIXTURE ONLY — NOT RTL-CALIBRATED. These fields parse but artifacts with them are ineligible for verdict.

frozen_policies.no_numerical_kernel_import: Provider registry MUST NOT import sim.models modules
frozen_policies.no_golden_executor_counters: Provider MUST NOT use scripts/extract_func_model_cycles.py or sim/golden_executor.py counters
frozen_policies.no_rtl_path: Provider MUST NOT reference rtl/** paths
frozen_policies.ceiling: All cycle estimates use math.ceil for integer rounding
frozen_policies.uncertainty_default: ±30% symmetric band for all architectural estimates
frozen_policies.spec_content_hash: Provider snapshots spec content hash at activation time
